faqs.q: What does Monoha Sourcing International do?
faqs.a: We help businesses with sourcing, supplier and business coordination through a structured, professional process.

faqs.q: What sourcing services do you provide?
faqs.a: Our main areas are international sourcing, product and supplier sourcing, business coordination and sourcing support. See the Services page for details.

faqs.q: How does your sourcing process work?
faqs.a: Seven steps: understand, research, source, coordinate, execute, review and deliver. The Our Process page explains each one.

faqs.q: How can I request a service?
faqs.a: Use the Request a Service form. Our team reviews each request and contacts you.

faqs.q: Do you work with international businesses?
faqs.a: Yes — where the requirement fits our services, we work with businesses inside and outside Bangladesh.

faqs.q: How can I contact your team?
faqs.a: Through the Contact page, by email or by phone.
